public static class MaskFormatterFactory.Builder<T extends MaskFormatterFactory.Builder<T>> extends FormatterFactory.Builder<T>
To build a new FormatterFactory with the specified parameters. Unless noted, a parameter is used when constructing the MaskFormatter.
